articles.name: Refunds overview
articles.title: Refunds overview
articles.body:
What we can refund

Nimbus can refund a payment made in error, a subscription cancelled within its cooling off period, or a duplicate payment.

What we cannot refund

We cannot refund a payment because you changed your mind. Where goods or services were received as described, the refund is a matter between you and the merchant.

articles.name: How to request a refund
articles.title: How to request a refund
articles.body:
Requesting a refund

Open the Nimbus app, go to Payments, select the payment, and choose Request a refund. You will be asked for a reason.

What happens next

We review the request and tell you the outcome. Most requests are reviewed within one business day.

If the app will not let you

Payments older than 180 days cannot be refunded through the app. Contact support instead.

articles.name: Refund timescales
articles.title: Refund timescales
articles.body:
How long a refund takes

Once approved, a refund reaches your Nimbus account within 5 to 10 business days.

Card payments

Refunds to a debit card can take up to 15 business days, because the card scheme controls the final step.

Delays

If your refund has not arrived after 15 business days, contact support.

articles.name: Refund timescales
articles.title: Refund timescales
articles.body:
How long a refund takes

Once approved, a refund reaches your Nimbus account within 3 to 5 business days.

Card payments

Refunds to a debit card usually arrive within 5 business days. The card scheme controls the final step.

Delays

If your refund has not arrived after 10 business days, contact support.

This article replaces our previous timescales, which applied before March 2026.

articles.name: Refunds for cancelled subscriptions
articles.title: Refunds for cancelled subscriptions
articles.body:
Cooling off period

Subscriptions bought through Nimbus can be cancelled within 14 days of purchase for a full refund, provided you have not used the service.

Partial use

If you have used the service during the 14 days, we refund the unused portion, calculated daily.

After 14 days

After 14 days the subscription runs to the end of its current term. We do not refund a partial term.

articles.name: When we cannot refund
articles.title: When we cannot refund
articles.body:
Payments we cannot refund

We cannot refund any of the following.

  • Gambling transactions
  • Cryptocurrency purchases
  • Cash withdrawals

Goods received as described

If you received what you paid for and changed your mind, we cannot refund it. The merchant's own returns policy applies.

Payments you authorised

A payment you authorised and recognise is not a refund matter. If you did not authorise it, report it as fraud instead.

articles.name: Refunds on business accounts
articles.title: Refunds on business accounts
articles.body:
Refunds on Nimbus Business

Business account refunds follow the terms in your business agreement, not the consumer terms in this help centre.

Cooling off

The 14 day consumer cooling off period does not apply to business accounts.

Who to contact

Business refund requests go to your account manager, not to general support.

articles.name: Subscriptions bought in an app store
articles.title: Subscriptions bought in an app store
articles.body:
Subscriptions bought in an app store

Where a subscription was purchased through the Apple App Store or Google Play using your Nimbus card, contact Nimbus to request a refund. We can raise the refund on your behalf.

What we need

The date of the charge and the name of the app.

articles.name: Subscriptions billed by a third party
articles.title: Subscriptions billed by a third party
articles.body:
Subscriptions billed by a third party

Where a subscription is billed by a third party, including the Apple App Store and Google Play, Nimbus cannot issue a refund. The refund must be requested from the provider that billed you.

What we can do

We can cancel the future payments so you are not billed again.

articles.name: Chargebacks and merchant disputes
articles.title: Chargebacks and merchant disputes
articles.body:
When to raise a dispute

If a merchant will not refund you and you paid by card, you may be able to raise a chargeback under the card scheme rules.

Deadlines

A chargeback must be raised within 120 days of the transaction.

This is not a refund

A chargeback is a formal dispute with the merchant's bank, handled by our disputes team. It is not a Nimbus refund.

articles.name: Goodwill refund limits
articles.title: Goodwill refund limits
articles.body:
Agent discretion

Agents may issue a goodwill refund of up to 50 pounds without approval where the customer's complaint is reasonable and policy does not require a refund.

Recording

Every goodwill refund must be recorded with a reason code. Unrecorded goodwill refunds are reversed at month end.

Limits

No more than two goodwill refunds per customer in any twelve month period.

articles.name: Refunds over 500 pounds
articles.title: Refunds over 500 pounds
articles.body:
Approval threshold

Any refund over 500 pounds requires approval from a team lead before it is issued.

Over 2000 pounds

Refunds over 2000 pounds require finance approval and are issued the following business day.

Do not commit to a date

Until approval is confirmed, do not give the customer a timescale.

articles.name: Refund requests from vulnerable customers
articles.title: Refund requests from vulnerable customers
articles.body:
Identifying vulnerability

Bereavement, serious illness, and severe financial hardship are vulnerability indicators. Refund requests from these customers route to specialist care.

Discretion

Normal refund limits may be waived at specialist care's discretion.

Never

Do not ask a vulnerable customer to repeat their circumstances to a second agent.

articles.name: Refund policy 2024
articles.title: Refund policy 2024
articles.body:
Refunds

Nimbus refunds payments made in error within 30 days of the payment date. Requests after 30 days are declined.

Timescales

Refunds take 10 to 20 business days.

articles.name: Refunds for cryptocurrency purchases
articles.title: Refunds for cryptocurrency purchases
articles.body:
Cryptocurrency purchases

We are reviewing whether cryptocurrency purchases made in error can be refunded. This article is not final and must not be relied on.
